description: An optional attribute set to null gets its default value
notes: The README says defaults populate missing optional attributes, without saying whether an attribute set to null is missing. The core spec says a null value represents the absence of a value and that applications should treat an attribute with a null value as not present (spec.md#null-values), but in a passage about body attributes, which spec.md#structural-types distinguishes from object attributes. hashicorp/hcl's Defaults.Apply (ext/typeexpr/defaults.go) uses the default for an attribute that is missing or null.
